caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl with a wide rim, viewed from above. The bowl is decorated with symmetrical floral designs painted primarily in shades of brown, red, and green. The central motif consists of a stylized, branching plant with elongated, curved leaves and flower-like forms. Two prominent curved shapes extend horizontally near the center, flanked by smaller, detailed elements that resemble flowers with cross-hatched patterns. The background of the inner surface is a pale, faded beige with scattered patches of green paint and bordered by continuous wavy lines in brown. The rim of the bowl is outlined with a thick brown band, and just inside the band, an undulating line runs parallel along the circumference. The bowl sits against a plain, light-colored background.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
